config.clock_definition: sin/cos of the UTC hour of day of each forecast step, from the panel timestamps
config.mask_definition: cell observed iff a collection run exists at its timestamp and the county reports within +/-7 days; hourly = mean of observed 15-min sub-steps; unobserved cells excluded from every loss and metric
config.metric_definition: RMSE over observed hourly cells at horizons 1/6/24/48 pooled over test samples
